full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 260

Beijing Chaoyang District Mou Environmental Research Institute v. Shanxi Mou Aluminium Industry Co., Ltd. — civil public interest litigation for environmental pollution

(Discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on May 26, 2025)

Keywords civil; civil public interest litigation for environmental pollution; mediation agreement; settlement agreement; substantive review; social public interest

Ruling Gist

1. Regarding mediation agreements or settlement agreements reached by parties in environmental civil public interest litigation on ecological environment restoration and other matters, a people's court shall conduct substantive review; if upon review the content of the agreement is sufficient to protect the social public interest, the court shall issue a consent judgment in accordance with law.

2. When reviewing a mediation agreement or settlement agreement, a people's court shall, in light of the specific circumstances of the case, focus on reviewing whether the agreement specifies concrete restoration measures, restoration period, restoration costs, acceptance procedures, supervising entities and other matters, and assess whether performance of the agreement can achieve the purpose of restoring the damaged ecological environment, reinstating the condition and functions of the ecological environment, and eliminating the risk of ecological environmental damage.

Basic Facts

Since 2006, Shanxi Mou Aluminium Industry Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co.) had been stacking red mud, an industrial solid waste discharged from extracting alumina from bauxite, at a red mud pond in Yuanping City, Shanxi Province. The red mud pond covers a total area of 1,840 mu (approximately 1,840 mu, with 1 mu ≈ 0.0667 hectares) and has a total storage capacity of 16.643 million cubic meters. Red mud is highly alkaline and highly corrosive. Being stored in the open for a long time, after the surface dries up, it forms dust during the windy season, causing serious air pollution and posing a significant threat to a national key cultural relic protection site located only 1 kilometer away. In November 2014, the Environmental Protection Bureau of Xinzhou City, Shanxi Province, found that the red mud pond of Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. had dust pollution, ordered the cessation of the illegal act, and imposed a fine. Due to technological iteration and upgrade, the red mud pond in question is no longer in use and should be closed in accordance with law; otherwise, it might cause geological disasters such as dam failure, posing risks to the safety of people's lives and property and the surrounding ecological environment.

On August 24, 2016, Beijing Chaoyang District Mou Environmental Research Institute (hereinafter referred to as Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute) filed a civil public interest lawsuit with the Intermediate People's Court of Xinzhou City, Shanxi Province, on the grounds that the red mud pond posed a major risk to the surrounding ecological environment and harmed the social public interest, requesting the court to order confirmation of the hazardous nature of the red mud in Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co.'s red mud pond and immediate adoption of measures such as closure to eliminate the harm and danger to the surrounding environment.

During the trial, after consultation, Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. and Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute reached a settlement agreement on January 18, 2017: 1. Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. promised to take measures in accordance with laws and regulations to ensure that the red mud pond meets national environmental protection requirements. 2. Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. promised that its annual expenditure on environmental governance, environmental personnel training, pollution prevention, investment in environmental protection facilities, operation and maintenance, material consumption, comprehensive treatment of the red mud pond, and other environment-related expenses shall not be less than RMB 50 million (currency unit: RMB). 3. After the agreement takes effect, Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. promised to set aside RMB 3 million and open a special account within two months as a special fund for environmental governance of the red mud pond, to ensure environmental governance of the red mud pond. The governance of the red mud pond is not limited to this special fund. 4. Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. voluntarily accepts supervision by Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute for a supervision period of three years starting from the day after the agreement takes effect. 5. Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. shall bear the attorney fees of Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute for this case. 6. Litigation costs shall be borne by Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co.

After review, the Intermediate People's Court of Xinzhou City held that, considering the scale of the red mud pond, the harmful consequences, the existing dust control measures, and the measures to be taken under the settlement agreement, failure to close the pond cannot fundamentally solve the pollution problem of the red mud pond, cannot achieve the effect of ecological environment restoration, and is insufficient to protect the social public interest, and therefore the settlement agreement could not be confirmed and no consent judgment would be issued. In view of the fact that the closure of red mud ponds is a worldwide technical challenge, and there was no prior experience in China in closing a red mud pond of similar scale, the Intermediate People's Court of Xinzhou City organized technical experts to conduct a field survey of the red mud pond, fully deliberated on the feasibility of closure, and guided the parties to renegotiate on restoration measures, restoration period, restoration costs, acceptance procedures, supervising entities, etc., with the aim of eliminating the ecological environmental risk.

On November 16, 2018, under the auspices of the people's court, Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. and Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute reached a mediation agreement: 1. Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. shall complete the closure of the red mud pond within five years after the mediation agreement takes effect, in accordance with the requirements of the administrative safety supervision departments and other state organs, and shall report in writing to Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute on the performance of the mediation agreement at least once a year and report to the people's court. 2. During the closure period, Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. shall take environmental pollution prevention measures as required, continue to take dust suppression measures such as watering and covering; strictly implement the ecological and environmental protection requirements in the feasibility study reports and design plans approved, recognized, or filed by the relevant administrative departments; prevent pollution of groundwater, soil, and atmosphere; and hire a third-party professional institution to test the quality of the environment (groundwater, atmosphere) around the red mud pond at least twice a year and issue test reports. 3. Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. shall raise all funds needed for the closure project on its own, with an estimated project cost of RMB 150 million. 4. If closure cannot be carried out due to natural, social, technical, or third-party reasons, Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. shall promptly notify the people's court and Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute in writing; after the reason is eliminated, the closure work shall continue, and the time limit shall be extended accordingly; if Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. explicitly refuses to close or delays closure, Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute may apply to the people's court to deduct or freeze the remaining project cost of Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. (with a total cap of RMB 150 million) and may apply to the people's court to entrust a qualified professional institution through bidding to complete the closure work, with the required costs paid directly from the deducted or frozen project cost. 5. After the closure project is completed, Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. shall organize an acceptance team composed of professional technical experts and representatives from the design, construction, monitoring (survey) units to conduct the completion environmental protection acceptance; only upon passing the acceptance shall the closure measures be deemed to have achieved the expected environmental protection effect.

On November 27, 2018, the Intermediate People's Court of Xinzhou City published the above mediation agreement for a period of thirty days; no objection was received during the publication period.

Judgment

The Intermediate People's Court of Xinzhou City, Shanxi Province, after reviewing, confirmed the mediation agreement reached between Shanxi Mou Aluminium Industry Co., Ltd. and Beijing Chaoyang District Mou Environmental Research Institute on November 16, 2018, and issued a Civil Consent Judgment ([2016] Jin 09 Min Chu No. 35) on December 28, 2018.

Reasoning

Paragraph 2 of Article 25 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Environmental Civil Public Interest Litigation (Fa Shi [2015] No. 1, hereinafter referred to as the Interpretation) provides: "...if upon review the people's court finds that the content of the mediation agreement or settlement agreement does not harm the social public interest, it shall issue a consent judgment..." Accordingly, mediation or self-settlement is permitted in environmental civil public interest litigation, but the people's court must conduct substantive review of the content of the mediation agreement or settlement agreement to confirm that the parties can lawfully exercise their litigation rights, so as to ensure that the content and performance of the agreement are sufficient to protect the social public interest.

In this case, Chaoyang Environmental Research Institute filed an environmental civil public interest lawsuit against Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co., and during the proceedings successively reached a settlement agreement and a mediation agreement. In this regard, the people's court shall review whether the content of the agreement reached by the parties on ecological environment restoration is sufficient to protect the social public interest, and then decide whether to issue a consent judgment. The review shall focus on whether the agreement specifies concrete restoration measures, restoration period, restoration costs, acceptance procedures, supervising entities and other matters, and assess, in light of the scope and degree of ecological environmental damage and the difficulty of restoring the ecological environment, whether performance of the agreement can achieve the purpose of restoring the damaged ecological environment, reinstating the condition and functions of the ecological environment, and eliminating the risk of ecological environmental damage.

When the parties reached the settlement agreement on January 18, 2017, the amount of red mud stored in the pond had reached the design maximum storage level; without closure the environmental problem could not be solved. However, the settlement agreement not only did not require Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. to close the red mud pond, but also did not specify concrete restoration measures or restoration period. It only required Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. to make a payment commitment, and did not specify the amount of funds to be used for restoring the environment around the red mud pond. Therefore, the settlement agreement reached by the parties was insufficient to restore the damaged ecological environment, could not reinstate the condition and functions of the ecological environment, and could not effectively eliminate the risk of ecological environmental damage. It did not meet the requirement under Article 25 of the Interpretation that the content of the settlement agreement "does not harm the social public interest," and accordingly the people's court did not issue a consent judgment.

On November 16, 2018, under the auspices of the people's court, the parties reached a mediation agreement, agreeing to raise RMB 150 million in project costs to complete the closure of the red mud pond within five years, thereby fundamentally solving the environmental problem of the red mud pond. In terms of the content of the mediation agreement, the parties made detailed provisions on the restoration period, restoration costs, restoration measures, alternative plans, supervising units, supervision methods, acceptance departments, etc. of the red mud pond. To ensure the reasonableness and feasibility of the agreement, the people's court published the above mediation agreement in accordance with law, and no objection was received during the publication period. In summary, the people's court found that the mediation agreement met the requirement under Article 25 of the Interpretation that the content of the mediation agreement "does not harm the social public interest," and issued a consent judgment in accordance with law.

After the case was closed, the people's court actively communicated with relevant administrative departments, clarified the standards and technical specifications for ecological restoration and governance of the reservoir area, and urged Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co. to formulate a closure plan and advance it on schedule. The total investment in the closure project was over RMB 130 million, mainly including the treatment of red mud and ash slag grading of 1.97 million cubic meters, the construction of 4 new drainage systems, the covering with soil of 380,000 cubic meters, and the laying of impermeable membrane and greening covering an area of 855,000 square meters. To ensure the timely completion of the closure project, the people's court conducted regular on-site follow-ups and continuously tracked the restoration progress. After five years of governance, the closure project was completed in November 2023 and passed the environmental protection acceptance; in December 2023, it passed the safety acceptance by the Shanxi Provincial Emergency Management Department, achieving the effect of restoring the ecological environment and eliminating the risk of damage. By then, all obligations under the civil consent judgment had been performed.

In addition, during the process of supervising Shanxi Mou Aluminium Co.'s performance of the obligations determined by the civil consent judgment, the people's court also guided the company to adjust and optimize its industrial layout, build a green development industrial cluster, and use the land resources after closure to develop clean energy projects such as solar energy, wind energy, and energy storage, achieving an organic unity of ecological, economic, and social benefits.

Relevant Legal Provisions

Article 1234 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China

Article 25 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Environmental Civil Public Interest Litigation (Fa Shi [2015] No. 1, revised in 2020)
